post.summary: Calculate a bounded hypothetical repeat-renewal calendar
post.description: Read-only constant-price UTC scenario. At most 90 days and 1000 events. One balance plus unlocked bonus is allocated once in due-time/service-ID order; withdrawBalance is excluded. Calendar months anchor to the original expiry. The baseline and its horizon stay unchanged; scenario horizon is reported separately. This is not a cash-flow prediction, payment promise or service deletion date.

post.description: Read-only rules-v1 search, ordered by cents, switch count, then service IDs. Score goals use a strict threshold. A complete certificate proves bounded minimality; search_limit does not prove unreachable. At most 100 due services, 8 toggle candidates, 10,000,000 cents and 6,144 search evaluations.

post.summary: Download a synthetic single-customer decision case
post.description: Read-only JSON attachment with rules-v1 inputs, fixed case as_of, settings, one strict model/action/solve operation, expected summary and canonical SHA-256. Uses the expected working revision before and after calculation. Synthetic labels and relative service ordering preserve the engine result; no other customers, transactions or source extras are exported. Maximum 64 KiB, 100 services and 8 switches. No server file is written.

post.summary: Recalculate a portable case in an isolated sandbox
post.description: Accepts {expected_revision, case_document: untouched UTF-8 JSON string}. Both the whole request and the embedded document have a 64 KiB byte cap. Validates schema, duplicate keys, checksum and supported format/engine/features before real engine calculation. Never writes source, settings, metrics or revisions. The active tuple is a concurrency guard checked before and after calculation; all calculation inputs come only from the case, including its own case_as_of, case_horizon_days and case_engine_version. Active as_of/model/source metadata does not replace case inputs. A case does not reproduce a portfolio ranking; a match proves reproducibility, not statistical accuracy or authorship.

get.summary: Read source freshness and evaluation coverage without refreshing data
get.description: Requires a session cookie. Captures one immutable evaluation and matching persisted source/settings revisions, retrying up to three times before 503 on a revision conflict. Receipt age is measured at checked_at with a fixed 24-hour (86400-second) threshold; exactly 24 hours is fresh. Missing receipt time is no_timestamp, future receipt time is future_timestamp. as_of is the evaluation time, received_at is source receipt time. Polling performs no evaluation refresh or source writes. Coverage includes every published customer, including unknowns, without filtering or pagination. Unknown and warning groups expose customer_ids for navigation. Source completeness is not established without an expected-count manifest; coverage does not measure model accuracy.

get.summary: Read observed source changes and separate workflow/model events
get.description: Session required. Read-only history, oldest first in deterministic order. customer_id filters source and workflow events; global model events remain visible. Source events retain received_at, consecutive revisions and fixed comparison provenance. Missing source records are labeled disappeared. No history is inferred before baseline. Offset pagination reads one SQLite snapshot per request; concurrent inserts can change later pages.
